# Quadra 12

> Quadra 12 is a free, distraction-free Class 12 CBSE PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics) study tracker, 3-hour Examination Hall, 12th Hackers one-shot lecture workspace, and community Help Desk created by AriYan Pal (Keśava Dāsa).

- Live URL: https://ariyanpal1008.github.io/Quadra12/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Ariyanpal1008/Quadra12
- Creator: AriYan Pal (Keśava Dāsa) (`ariyanpal090@gmail.com`)
- Copyright: © 2026 Quadra 12 · Invented November 2026

## About the Creator

I am a Class 12 student currently preparing for board exams.
- The Problem: Keeping board exam preparation organized and finding one clean, distraction-free study tracker was a real struggle.
- The Solution: I built this app to solve that exact problem for myself and other students facing the same challenge.

## Navigation & UI Controls

- **Top Header Bar:** Wordmark (`Quadra 12`), 4 primary tabs (`Overview`, `Subject Tracker`, `Examination Hall`, `12th Hackers`), Light/Dark theme switch, `Enter Exam Hall` shortcut, and mobile `☰` menu (containing all 4 tabs plus direct links to **About the Creator** and **Help Desk**).
- **Footer Dock:** Displays copyright (`© 2026 Quadra 12 · Invented November 2026`), creator credit, and buttons for **Help Desk**, **About & Disclaimers**, and **Suggest Addition / Change**, plus independent educational disclaimers.

## Main Workspace Features

1. **Overview**
   - Features a live Apple-style CBSE Class 12 Board Exam Countdown Clock (`Days · Hours · Minutes · Seconds` synced to Feb 16, 10:30 AM IST) with remaining-chapter urgency tracking, custom date adjustment, and automatic annual rollover (`2027 → 2028` on Feb 16).
   - Shows combined mastery across all 50 NCERT Class 12 chapters (200 checkpoints), completed subjects (`/ 4`), CBSE sample papers attempted (`/ 4`), and 12th Hackers lectures watched (`/ 50`).
   - Displays individual cards for Physics (042), Chemistry (043), Biology (044), and Mathematics (041) with live progress bars (100% completion shimmer), subject-level stage checkboxes, and Best Sample Paper scores.
   - Includes a gamified **Achievements** section with 9 milestone badges (such as **Quick Learner** for completing 3–5 chapters in a single day, **Syllabus Sprinter** for 5 chapters in a day, **Exam Ready** for scoring >90% on an official CBSE sample paper, **Four-Stage Purist**, **Subject Champion**, and **Quadra 12 Grandmaster**) with live progress meters, category filters (`All`, `Unlocked`, `Locked`), and instant unlock notifications.

2. **Subject Tracker**
   - Covers Physics (14 chapters), Chemistry (10 chapters), Biology (13 chapters), and Mathematics (13 chapters).
   - Tracks 4 stages per chapter: `Lecture done`, `Practice done`, `NCERT done`, and `PYQ done`. Checking all 4 stages automatically marks the chapter complete.
   - Includes one-click bulk stage toggles per subject, `Mark Subject Complete` / `Reset`, and 50 interactive custom SVG study diagrams (one per chapter).

3. **Examination Hall**
   - Embeds official CBSE 2026–27 Sample Question Paper PDFs (Physics 70 marks, Chemistry 70 marks, Biology 70 marks, Mathematics 80 marks) with offline PDF download.
   - Provides a 3-hour (`03:00:00`) countdown timer (Start, Pause, Reset), an interactive 33/38-question OMR & written checklist, instant Section A MCQ auto-grading, and per-subject Best Exam Score tracking.

4. **12th Hackers**
   - Organizes all 50 official one-shot video lectures across Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics with unit notes, high-yield board topics, key formulas, and playlist queue.
   - Bidirectionally synced with `Lecture done` in Subject Tracker.
   - Includes 3 embed modes (`Player: Standard`, `Player: Pure Embed`, `Player: No-Cookie`), YouTube `postMessage` completion detection, an `Open Quadra 12 in Full Tab` helper when viewed inside nested frames, and an **"Open on YouTube" + "Mark Done & Next"** quick return bar.

## Help Desk, Suggestion Box & Creator Inbox

- **Help Desk Tab:** Explains every tab of Quadra 12 (Overview, Subject Tracker, Examination Hall, 12th Hackers) with step-by-step usage tips and one-click navigation buttons.
- **Interactive Tour Tab:** Sandbox visual walkthrough inside Help Desk letting visitors test interactive previews of the Board Countdown Clock, My Achievements (*Quick Learner*, *Exam Ready*), Subject Tracker 4-stage checkboxes, Examination Hall OMR bubbles, and 12th Hackers player.
- **Creator & Disclaimers Tab:** Presents the **About the Creator** story alongside full **Disclaimers & Credits** and **Terms & Conditions (Copyright & Fair Use)**—covering non-commercial student use, CBSE & 12th Hackers third-party copyright ownership, no official affiliation, copyright/takedown notice procedure (`ariyanpal090@gmail.com`), and warranty limitations.
- **Suggest Addition / Change (Suggestion Box) Tab:**
  - Visitors can select a request type (`Add New Feature / Content`, `Change Existing Design / Flow`, `Syllabus / Chapter Correction`, `Report an Issue`), choose a target tab (`Full Website`, `Overview`, `Subject Tracker`, `Examination Hall`, `12th Hackers`), enter a title and details, and submit directly to Firebase Cloud Firestore after Google Sign-In.
  - Signed-in visitors can track their own submitted requests (`Submitted`, `Planned`, `Added / Updated`), view creator reply notes, or withdraw new requests.
  - Also includes an **Email Creator Directly** (`mailto:ariyanpal090@gmail.com`) option that works without signing in.
- **Creator Inbox Tab:** Private moderation queue visible only when signed in as the verified creator (`ariyanpal090@gmail.com`) to update request statuses, write reply notes, or remove items.

## Data Storage & Privacy

- All study progress (chapter checkboxes, 4-stage tasks, watched lectures, exam best scores, daily chapter velocity log, achievements, custom board date, and Light/Dark theme) is saved locally in browser `localStorage` (`pcmb_desk_*`), requiring no account or sign-in.
- Google Sign-In is optional and used only for submitting or tracking community suggestions in Cloud Firestore (`changeRequests`).
